summary: Klamath County lookout tower on Lookout Butte near Crater Lake, dated 1942 (1932 in some sources), removed or destroyed in 1972; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 40' wooden L-4 tower with a 14x14 cab
facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in 1972; no source describes what remains at the site
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Rogue River and Winema National Forests

events.note: Build year per the Klamath lookouts blog and a March 1942 Forest Service memo on buying materials; the register and firelookout.com say 1932
Glenn Davis stationed on Lookout Butte as the Rogue River forest placed lookouts at posts (first staffing in our sources)
Mr. and Mrs. Ray Antley to operate the tower (Herald and News, June 30, 1949)
Fire apparently started by a cigarette burned about half an acre of lodgepole pine; Antley and a Lake of the Woods crew fought it (July 11, 1949 item)
Newspaper item: porkies consumed most of the tires off two cars parked on the butte over two summers
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description: four-legged wooden tower about 60 feet high
Ben Hunnemuller spent a month as fire lookout and weather station reporter
Register says removed; firelookout.com says destroyed

corrections.why: Register, firelookout.com and the Klamath blog all describe a 40-foot tower (12.2 m); 18.3 m matches only the 60-foot figure in a 1953 Coast and Geodetic Survey description

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and firelookout.com give 1932; the Klamath blog gives 1942, and a March 1942 memo discusses buying materials for the project. The story gives both and leans toward 1942 without settling it.
Register, firelookout.com and the blog give 40 feet; a 1953 Coast and Geodetic Survey description gives about 60 feet. The record uses 40 feet.
Register says removed in 1972; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1972. Both agree on the year.

notes_for_editor: Build year (1932 vs 1942) and height (40 vs about 60 ft) conflict across sources; the brief height of 18.3 m is proposed as a correction to 12.2 m. No source describes the site today. Search results for Lookout Butte mostly return an unrelated rentable tower in the Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forest, Idaho, which is not this site. No new photos taken from the fetched text: the register photo caption (2007, Ron Kemnow) has no image URL in our fetched text.
